brief:
Netanyahu laid out 10 conditions for forming a unity government with Eisenkot, including full control of the prime minister's office and rejection of an official inquiry committee, according to Shehab Wire. The conditions were presented as a framework for coalition talks between the two figures.

Eisenkot's camp dismissed the proposal as a media maneuver, rejecting the terms Netanyahu set forth for any potential power-sharing arrangement.

title: Netanyahu sets 10 conditions for unity government with Eisenkot
